remaining_risks: All numerical balance settings (base shot probabilities 20%/12%/7%, up to +8% Street Flow/Combo setup bonus, 35% correctness bonus, 35% speed bonus, 200ms tie tolerance) are deterministic playtest values and remain subject to empirical SPX101 educator calibration.
